1479-2841-4862-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-4862-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2728-5686-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-5686-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-5686-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-5233-7889.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Dancing from Dark to Dawn, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

553-1927-4586.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Vedalken Orrery.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

3375-4399-4518-5789.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-5789.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3617-6568-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-3689-6518-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1020-3689-6518-7693.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

924-4149-4599-4871-4885.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4871-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4871-4885.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4871-4885.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

2173-4446-4496-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2173-4446-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2239-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2511-5007.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.
628-2511-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an artifact you control

2047-7343.manaNeeded: {8}{G}{G} minus {1} for each Mutagen you control
2047-7343.description:
Cast Mutagen Man by paying {8}{G}{G} minus {1} for each Mutagen you control.
When Mutagen Man enters, it triggers, creating a number of Mutagen tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a copy of the artifact it's attached to and causing you to win the game.
2047-7343.notes: The cost can be reduced by an additional {1} if Mechanized Production happens to be attached to a Mutagen.

2510-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2510-3532-5078-7328.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-4742.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2034-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5256-6094.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

7-5638-7070.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least four Equipment.
7-5638-7070.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Plate Armor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat.

1978-3263-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
1978-3263-6478.description:
Cause Arbor Adherent to become an artifact using Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat from step 2.

3025-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3025-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2751-3649-5904.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2751-3649-5904.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Adric and Strionic Resonator by paying {4}{U} and tapping them, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

2034-5496-6351-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Teval triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.
2034-5496-6351-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

856-2921-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1115-1563-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1251-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2281-3305-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

413-643-1429-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-643-1429-5402.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1170-1645-5478-5921-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-1018-2072.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-2072.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4893-5241-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3719-4893-5241-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima's Student has a power of at least 2.
3719-4893-5241-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima's Student and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima's Student from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima's Student to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima's Student enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima's Student by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

280-804-1479.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

352-2097-4539-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
352-2097-4539-5195.description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating three Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-1339-2034-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

2034-3263-3498-3615.description:
Cast Baithook Angler from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Hook-Haunt Drifter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hook-Haunt Drifter, adding {2}.
Because Humility causes Hook-Haunt Drifter to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Baithook Angler.
Repeat.

1981-3499-4050-4498.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
1981-3499-4050-4498.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each player and each creature your opponent control.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1102-2060-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Steel Overseer.
Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
1102-2060-3525.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Steel Overseer.
Repeat.

2459-2842-2906-5147.notablePrerequisites: The amount of life opponents have lost this turn is equal to or greater than Rograkh's commander tax.
2459-2842-2906-5147.description:
Cast Rograkh for {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return from the graveyard to the command zone.
Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Repeat.

568-721-2724.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand and putting Capsize back into your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1295-1771-1901-1930.description:
Cast Mana Severance for {1}{U}, exiling all lands in your library.
Activate Undercity Informer for {1}, milling your library.
Cast Unburial Rites for {3}{W}, returning Thassa's Oracle to the battlefield.
Thassa's Oracle ETBs, winning the game.

224-1257-3861.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

364-1987-3448-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.

654-880-4488.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-4488.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

950-1671-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
950-1671-4222.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
